landingPage.headline: Real introductions
landingPage.subheadline: Talk to Juno like you would a brilliant friend. He'll learn what matters, make one thoughtful introduction, and only connect you when you both say yes.

demoConversation.text: Hi, I'm Juno. I introduce one real person at a time — never a list.
Tell me about yourself and who you're looking for. I'll start with what actually matters.

gallery.heading: Dating apps gave you everyone. Juno introduces you to someone.
gallery.body: He learns the details that never fit in a bio — the pace of life you want, what makes you laugh, and the ordinary Tuesday you hope to share.

mainCard.title: Specific beats endless.
mainCard.body: Juno filters for shared values, compatible lives, and the kind of spark you can actually build on.

ctaCard.title: A person, not a profile.
ctaCard.body: Every introduction comes with a reason Juno thinks you two should meet — not a mysterious percentage.

smallCardA.title: He remembers the details.
smallCardA.body: Including the ones you only mention once.

smallCardB.title: Private, always.
smallCardB.body: No public deck. No strangers browsing you.

howItWorks.heading: From "tell me about you" to "when can we meet?"

steps.title: Have a real conversation
steps.body: Tell Juno what you want, what has not worked, and what a good relationship feels like to you.

steps.title: Juno does the looking
steps.body: He searches the private community for compatible people and checks the fit beyond the obvious.

steps.title: Meet one good possibility
steps.body: Get a thoughtful introduction with context. You both opt in before anything is shared.

steps.title: Go on an actual date
steps.body: Juno can suggest the place, break the ice, and use your feedback to make the next introduction even sharper.

matchPreview.heading: Two full lives. One very good reason to meet.
matchPreview.body: They both cross town for great bread, call their family on Sundays, and would rather host dinner than shout over a bar.

stories.heading:
Dates people text
their friends about.
stories.quote: Juno skipped the small talk. Our first date lasted four hours, and our second happened two days later.

faqs.question: Is Juno a dating app?
faqs.answer: Not really — there's no swipe deck or public profile. You tell Juno who you are and what you want, and he makes one thoughtful introduction at a time.

faqs.question: Will everyone see my profile?
faqs.answer: No. Your profile is private by default. Juno only shares an approved introduction with someone he thinks could be a fit — never in a public or searchable feed.

faqs.question: What if I'm not interested in a match?
faqs.answer: Just tell Juno. Declining never penalizes you or the other person, and he'll keep looking until it's right.

faqs.question: Is Juno free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, chatting with Juno and getting introductions is free.

contact.heading: Have a question for the team?
contact.body: Juno can answer most questions directly in chat — or reach out to us by email.

closing.heading:
Real introductions.
one person at a time.
closing.body: Tell Juno what matters to you. He'll take it from there — thoughtfully, privately, and one real person at a time.
